subject: Payment retry orchestration & VAT billing entity alignment
messages:
From: Claire Dawson <claire.dawson@auroracorp.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Failed capture on INV-2026-09-001 — VAT entity mismatch?

Hi Neha,

We just received a notice from our finance team that the attempted charge for invoice INV-2026-09-001 failed this morning (Stripe decline: card_declined / incorrect_address). Our payments team also flagged a VAT entity mismatch — the invoice shows Aurora Global but this customer should be billed to Aurora EU (VAT ID ending in GB123456).

Can you advise the minimal steps to get this retried without generating a chargeback? We have the cardholder on the line and can either provide an updated card or approve a retry if you need auth from our side. Our priority is to avoid service interruption; we can provide the VAT registration if that helps.

Attaching the invoice and the merchant decline notice.

Thanks,
Claire
Billing Operations
Aurora Corp
attachments: INV-2026-09-001.pdf, decline_notice.png
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Claire Dawson <claire.dawson@auroracorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Failed capture on INV-2026-09-001 — VAT entity mismatch?

Hi Claire —

Thanks for the heads up and for attaching the invoice. Short plan to get this resolved quickly:

1) Collections flow: we can attempt a single automatic retry against the existing token once we confirm you want us to proceed. If you prefer, we can send a secure hosted payment link (expires 24h) for a card rotation.

2) VAT/entity: switching the billed legal entity from Aurora Global -> Aurora EU requires issuing a corrected invoice and updating the billing entity on the account. That will likely postpone a retry by ~24-48 hours while our billing team issues the amendment. If you need immediate capture to stop service disruption, you can approve the retry now and we can reconcile VAT corrections after capture.

3) Chargeback risk: to reduce risk, please ask the cardholder to confirm the transaction in writing (simple one-line approval is fine) and keep any receipts/communication available — we will attach these to any dispute packet if needed.

Marissa, can you advise on the fastest way to (a) trigger a safe retry and (b) generate a short-lived update link for the customer? Rishi — if Claire confirms Aurora EU is the right entity, can your team fast-track the corrected invoice and VAT evidence?

Claire — if you can confirm (a) which path you prefer (retry now vs rotate card) and (b) correct billed entity, we’ll act immediately.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Claire Dawson <claire.dawson@auroracorp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Failed capture on INV-2026-09-001 — VAT entity mismatch?

Hi all —

I can run the retry and provision a hosted instrument-rotation link. Notes from collections:
- We will attempt one immediate retry using the token currently on file; success rate is ~58% for this decline pattern.
- If you prefer a hosted update link, I can generate it now; link TTL = 24 hours and it will automatically exchange the card for a new Stripe token (we store token, not card PAN).
- If we need to change the billed legal entity before capture, we must void/reissue the invoice to Aurora EU — that typically adds 24-48 hours due to tax validation.

I attached the recent collection log from Stripe for this merchant (stripedown of events) to help troubleshooting.

Action items:
- Claire: confirm: (1) try token retry now OR (2) provide new card via hosted link, and (3) whether to bill Aurora EU (VAT confirmed).
- If option 1 chosen: I will schedule a retry window today (two attempts over 4h) and flag for manual follow-up on decline.

Marissa
Senior Collections Manager
Redwood Inference
attachments: stripe-collection-log.txt
From: Claire Dawson <claire.dawson@auroracorp.com>

Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 08:09:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Failed capture on INV-2026-09-001 — VAT entity mismatch?

Neha / Marissa —

Thanks. Confirming Aurora EU (VAT GB123456) is the correct billing entity for this invoice — I attached the VAT registration. Our payments lead (Arthur Hsu) is now on thread and has approved the retry.

We would prefer: Option 2 (hosted rotation) — we will update the card; Arthur will provide the new details (or the cardholder will input on the link). Please generate the hosted link and set TTL to 24h. If for any reason the card entry fails, you are authorized to attempt one retry on the existing token.

Please note: if capture does not succeed by Fri 10/8 EOD our procurement policy will put the account into a temporary hold — would appreciate a quick turnaround.

Claire
Billing Operations
Aurora Corp

Subject: Re: Failed capture on INV-2026-09-001 — VAT entity mismatch?

Hi Claire / Arthur —

Quick status: hosted payment link created and sent to Arthur (HubSpot activity: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/auroracorp/activity/8765). Arthur confirmed via secure form and we received a tokenized instrument.

I initiated a token swap with Stripe and scheduled a retry window (one immediate attempt + fallback after 3 hours). Stripe responded with a successful auth and capture at 15:58 PDT — funds are now settled. I attached the collection log and the VAT evidence has been applied to the account; Rishi will confirm the invoice reissue for Aurora EU today (you will get a creditor invoice with corrected VAT lines).

Attachments: stripe-collection-log.txt (updated), evidence_vat_registration.pdf

Next steps:
- Rishi: please finalize the corrected invoice and send the credit/reissued invoice.
- Neha/Marissa: will keep an eye for any chargeback activity for the next 120 days and share the dispute packet if needed.

Claire / Arthur — let me know if you want a one-pager on our payment retry/logs for your audit.

Thanks everyone — glad we could avoid disruption.

Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
